questions: Should the random array be generated with a fixed seed for reproducibility, or should it be truly random each time?
What is the shape of the output array? Should it be a 1D array of length 10 or a 2D column array of shape (10, 1)?
Should the scaling be applied per array (global min/max) or per feature (if array were multi-dimensional)?
What should happen if all input values are identical (e.g., all zeros)? Should scaling produce all zeros, all 0.5, or handle it specially?
Is the array length fixed at 10, or should the function generate an array of length ARRAY_LENGTH (which is 10 but could be changed)?
Should the output values be floats or integers?
Is the function allowed to have side effects, like modifying global state or printing?
Should the scaling range always be exactly [0, 1], or could it be a different range like (0, 1) if min/max are not present?
